task: Clarify Koala terminal outcome semantics without changing lifecycle gates.
outcome: When the user runs session_brief or dashboard after mixed DONE stories, they see lifecycle progress plus outcome counts such as DONE-success, DONE-blocked, DONE-audit-only; blocked spike evidence renders as a classified verdict instead of a misleading happy-path pass/fail.
facts: Dashboard currently computes doneStories by story.phase === DONE and renders only N/M DONE percent.
Story summary has acceptanceVerdict accepted/partial/rejected but no outcome kind for blocked or audit-only completion.
VerificationEvidence has kind/result/waiverType but no verdict field for blocked-classified or audit-only evidence.
session_brief already detects worktree authority and mainPhase lag but wording says main metadata still says X.
INIT reviewers both passed but flagged CHK-005 as needing user-visible outcome, not a test-only item.
constraints: Do not split DONE into new lifecycle phases because story_advance, cleanup, audit trigger, and historical story data depend on DONE.
Keep existing pass/fail/waiver behavior backward compatible for old evidence and old summary.json.
Outcome semantics must not weaken TEST/DONE gates; blocked/audit outcomes are display and explicit evidence semantics, not a bypass.
Do not expand aux_doc_list scope in this story.
Use existing repo smoke-test style rather than introducing a new test framework.
